items.title: Merced detective receives Honor the Honorable: The Attorney General’s Award for Distinguished Service in Policing
items.summary: Detective Jennifer Dabney of the Merced Police Department has received the Honor the Honorable: The Attorney General’s Award for Distinguished Service in Policing, one of the Department of Justice's highest honors for state and local law enforcement officers. U.S. Attorney Eric Grant attended the ceremony where Attorney General Todd Blanche announced the award recipients. This award represents the Department of Justice’s reaffirmed commitment to uplifting the valor and exceptional contributions to policing of our great nation’s law enforcement personnel.

items.title: Woman From Democratic Republic of Congo Appears in Federal Court for Illegal Voting
items.summary: RENO – Mlebinge Riziki Ramadhani, from the Democratic Republic of Congo and a lawful permanent resident, made her initial appearance in federal court Tuesday for allegedly illegally voting in the 2022 General Election.

items.title: Las Vegas Man Appears in Court for Carjacking Resulting in the Death of Another Man
items.summary: LAS VEGAS – A Las Vegas man made his initial appearance in federal court Tuesday for allegedly fatally striking a person during a carjacking.

items.title: Temu commits to complying with EU consumer protection rules following action by national authorities
items.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 26 Nov 2026 Following a coordinated action by the European Commission and the Consumer Protection Cooperation (CPC) Network, the online marketplace Temu has committed to bring several of its commercial practices in line with EU consumer protection laws. The CPC Network accepted Temu's commitments today.

items.title: 🎩 Tech Monopolies Make Outages Worse | EFFector 38.21
items.summary: Service outages, like the ones we've seen take down everything from airlines to email, seem to be coming faster than ever. Their specific causes might be different, but these wide-scale service disruptions share one thing in common: the over-reliance on one company or system to make our world work. In our latest EFFector newsletter , we're talking about how digital monoculture has made tech companies too big to fail . JOIN OUR NEWSLETTER For over 35 years, EFFector has been your guide to understanding the intersection of technology, civil liberties, and the law. This issue covers ALPR at the ballot box , surveillance wearables , and how digital monoculture makes service outages worse . Prefer to listen in? EFFector is now available on all major podcast platforms. This time we're talking to EFF's Rory Mir about tech monopolies, service outages, and what we can do to build a more resilient internet.
